text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon, thank you for helping me take
care of
the flowers!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It proved to be an effective lower-body
workout.
I assume this is the secret to
your strong legs.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Incorporating new activity into training
regimen...
Ideal set amount: three
thousand meters' worth of
flowers.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What?! But that's the same as a
long-distance
race! If you water all those
flowers, you'll pass
out!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... Imagine it! Three thousand meters
of
flowers! I bet running alongside that
many flowers
would be wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Beginning simulation. Body
temperature rising.
Warm and fuzzy
feelings confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This would work both as training and
relaxation...
Flowers are indeed very
intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... If you like, we can water them
together
again sometime! ♪
